## FX Index Dashboard

All currencies begin at **100** in Round 0.

::: {.callout-note}
**How to read this table:** Higher scores indicate strengthening / inflows. Lower scores indicate depreciation pressure / outflows.
:::

| Country | FX Index | Status | Notes |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Agrona | 98 | Slight softening | Structural exposure to external volatility keeps markets cautious. |
| Atlantica | 102 | Stable / slightly strengthening | Floating regime and neutral policy keep Atlantica calm and credible. |
| Frontieria | 103 | Strengthening | Tight policy, austerity, and capital restrictions support stability. |
| Industralia | 101 | Stable | Tight monetary policy and managed capital flows support confidence. |
| Mercatoria | 100 | Stable | Balanced policy mix produces no strong directional pressure. |
| Noravia | 101 | Stable | Tight monetary policy supports the currency, though markets watch policy consistency. |
| Pacifica | 99 | Stable | Managed regime and open capital create exposure, but discipline contains pressure. |
| Petrovia | 99 | Stable | Markets remain neutral but cautious toward a managed, resource-linked economy. |

::: {.callout-important}
**Reminder:** The FX Index is a summary indicator. Your job is to submit a coherent policy package that restores confidence or adjusts the regime.
:::
